subject: Vendor setup: Mediatech onboarding prerequisites and evidence request
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@mediatech.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-10T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor intake - Mediatech onboarding prerequisites

Hi Rachel,

We're finalizing procurement for the upcoming contract and need to initiate vendor setup on our side. Can you confirm what documentation Redwood requires before we issue a PO? Our standard checklist asks for:
- SOC 2 report (Type II) or letter of attestation
- ISO 27001 certification evidence (if available)
- Penetration test attestation/summary (redacted ok)
- Completed vendor intake form (attached)
- Billing remit and PO contact information

I've attached our intake form (Mediatech_Intake_Form.pdf). Targeting a Feb 1 start; procurement would like to know if any of these items will cause a delay. Also, we usually require a countersigned MSA before PO issuance — please confirm your signing process and if Redwood accepts DocuSign.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Nguyen
Procurement Manager | Mediatech Solutions
(555) 512-9987
(Attachment: Mediatech_Intake_Form.pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@mediatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake - Mediatech onboarding prerequisites

Hi Claire —

Thanks for sending the intake form and the heads up on timing. Welcome — excited to get started. Quick summary of what we can provide and the typical timeline:

What Redwood will provide (standard):
- SOC 2 Type II report (we can provide a redacted PDF suitable for vendor review) — ETA: 1–2 business days to prepare redacted copy once requested.
- Penetration test attestation letter (summary + attestation from our security team) — ETA: same day to 2 business days.
- ISO 27001: We have controls aligned with ISO; we can provide the attestation statement and any certificate copies if requested.
- Vendor onboarding checklist (attached) with fields we need you to complete for PO issuance (billing contact, remit address, legal entity name, tax id).

What we need from Mediatech:
- Completed intake form (you attached) + preferred billing contact and PO number template.
- Primary technical contact for any security questions (name/email).
- Copy of your standard procurement requirements where specific artifact formatting is required (e.g., exact redaction rules).

Process notes and next steps:
1) Please confirm the name/email for PO billing and the email to route the signed MSA (we accept DocuSign).
2) We'll upload the redacted SOC 2 and pen test attestation to a secure share and send the link to your security contact.
3) Once MSA is countersigned, billing can issue the PO — typical lead time from signed MSA to PO issuance at Mediatech?

Attached: Redwood_Procurement_Checklist_v1.pdf (contains the minimal legal & billing fields we require).

I'll loop in Karthik for any procurement/legal questions and Monica from operations to confirm billing flow.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Lead, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
(Attachment: Redwood_Procurement_Checklist_v1.pdf)

From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@mediatech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Jameson <tim.jameson@mediatech.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake - Mediatech onboarding prerequisites

Thanks Rachel — that's helpful. A couple of clarifications from our end:

- PO timing: Our procurement team typically issues the PO within 3 business days of having a countersigned MSA and the billing remit information on file. If Redwood can provide the redacted SOC 2 and pen test attestation this week, procurement should be able to meet the Feb 1 start.
- Redaction rules: We can accept vendor-redacted SOC 2 reports (removing auditor-privileged details and customer lists) and redacted vuln summaries for pen tests.
- MSA: We'll route DocuSign once legal has the final MSA PDF. Can you confirm Redwood's billing email and whether we should include a PO reference format (we use PO-####-MMYY).

Primary technical/security contact for Mediatech: Tim Jameson (tim.jameson@mediatech.com).

Also, is there a standard place you prefer we upload the completed intake form, or should we email it back to you?

Claire
(Attachment: —)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@mediatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake - Mediatech onboarding prerequisites

Hi Claire / Tim —

Great — thanks for confirming. Short answers and next actions:

- Billing / PO routing: Please have the PO sent to billing@redwood.com and include the PO reference in the body using your PO-####-MMYY format. Our billing team will ack and map to the contract.
- MSA: We accept DocuSign. I'll upload the MSA to the DocuSign link below and will notify your legal team when it's ready for signature.
- Evidence delivery: We'll place the redacted SOC 2 (SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf) and the PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf on a secure share (link below) and grant Tim access. Estimated delivery: within 24 business hours.

Deliverables and timeline:
- Today (by end of day): upload redacted SOC2 + pen test attestation to secure share; send DocuSign MSA link.
- Once MSA countersigned (expected <3 business days): Mediatech issues PO.
- On PO receipt: provisioning and kickoff (we'll confirm an implementation schedule).

Questions for Mediatech to complete the checklist:
- Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the PO
- Billing address and remit-to details
- Tax ID / VAT (if applicable)
- Primary billing contact name + email

Secure share link: https://redwood-secure-share.example.com/mediatech-onboarding
DocuSign MSA: https://app.docusign.com/MsA-Redwood-Mediatech-2027

Attachments included for immediate download: SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf (Attachment), PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf (Attachment)

I'll keep you posted and notify when the evidence is uploaded. If you prefer I send the intake form back via email once completed, either way works — whichever is easiest for your procurement portal.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Lead, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
(Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf, PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf)
